name: Government of Samara Oblast
note: Regional government of Samara Oblast, a federal subject of the Russian Federation. Listed by HC Lada as a founder ('Учредитель') of the club; the 'САМАРСКАЯ ОБЛАСТЬ' name and coat of arms appear across the front hem of the club's 2026-27 home jersey. The region funds the club from its budget (Vedomosti, 27.02.2023; zhiguli63.info, 19.05.2026).
